visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a white lace dress, playing a grand piano with great passion and a broad smile. The setting is a minimalist white studio with bright, even lighting. (2) She finishes playing and raises her arm triumphantly, then looks directly at the camera in a medium shot, waving and beginning to speak energetically. (3) The camera cuts to various close-ups of her face as she talks, interspersed with text bubble graphics and a cartoonish illustration of a student praying for guidance. (4) A full-screen promotional graphic appears, featuring a large portrait of the woman, the title of the course, and classical music notations in the background. (5) Fast cuts follow, showing her performing in a formal concert hall wearing a black sequined gown, then back to the studio where she is teaching a male student. (6) She continues her presentation in the white studio, gesturing broadly. Illustrations of four classical composers appear in circular icons above her head as she discusses learning piano. (7) The video concludes with her pointing to the camera and then down to a link, followed by a final static screen with text instructions for joining the course.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大家好我是江老師. [Logo]: @TeacherChiang. (2) [Slogan]: 我最常被私訊的問題一定都有. (3) [Variety]: 江老師還有教學生嗎? [Variety]: 老師幽默風趣的話我就不會放棄鋼琴了. [Variety]: 老師有推薦自學的鋼琴線上課程嗎? (4) [Slogan]: 你們的心聲我都聽到了. (5) [Slogan]: 跟著江老師彈鋼琴. [Slogan]: 用 12 首經典聽懂規律、彈出靈魂. [Slogan]: 江老師給你的人生第一堂鋼琴課. (6) [Slogan]: 低痛苦 高回饋 練琴策略. (7) [Slogan]: 度過練琴的苦悶與孤獨的時刻. [Slogan]: 練琴的辛酸誰人知. (8) [Slogan]: 12首經典曲目. [Slogan]: 手指和前臂應保持穩定, 彈奏八度時. (9) [Slogan]: 解鎖自己喜歡的曲子. [Slogan]: 彈奏公式. (10) [Slogan]: 讓你不只是彈音符 更能彈出靈魂. (11) [Slogan]: 點擊下方的連結 留言「第一堂鋼琴課」. (12) [Slogan]: 原來鋼琴可以這麼好玩. (13) [Slogan]: 點擊連結 OR 留言：「第一堂鋼琴課」 立即查看詳情.

She speaks rapidly and enthusiastically, greeting the audience. The piano continues as a vibrant background bed. (3) A series of 'pop' and 'ding' SFXs punctuate her speech as she lists questions. Her vocal pitch is high with significant variability, conveying excitement. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat major-mode rhythm. (5) A cartoonish comedy SFX is heard as she mimics a frustrated learner. Her voice briefly adopts a melodramatic tone before returning to professional confidence. (6) The video winds down with a clear, authoritative call-to-action. The piano music swells slightly for a final melodic flourish, ending with a clean stinger SFX and fading into silence.
